_comment: The search contract. Every implementation — the JS one in src/search.js, and any Python one added later — must agree with every case here. Run the JS side with `npm test`. A Python side should load this same file and assert the same pairs, so 'the two agree' is checked rather than assumed.
_shape: fields: the strings a record exposes to search. query: what the user typed. expect: whether it should match.

cases.why: the reported case: the tier is a CJK Roman numeral, the reader types a digit
and the other direction
the digit reaches the English name's ASCII numeral
the ASCII numeral reaches the same record
Ⅰ and Ⅳ fold too
Ⅹ folds to two digits
124 names use full-width parentheses
and the full-width query still works
whitespace is not significant
nor is a stray space in the query
case is not significant
the item key is searchable
a key fragment is searchable
an empty query matches everything
so does whitespace only
a missing field must not throw
no false positive on an unrelated query
a bare 'i' is not folded to 1
but the literal digit still is
the numeral must be present, not implied
